title: Meet Wally the Wolf
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for Shellfie.

pages: Meet Wally the Wolf! Wally is a gray wolf. He lives in a big, snowy forest.
Wally lives in a pack. A pack is a wolf family: a mom, a dad, and their pups and big kids. They play, hunt, and sleep together.
Ah-WOOOO! Wolves howl to call the pack together. A howl can also tell other wolves, "This is our home. Stay away!"
Wolves eat meat. The pack works as a team to hunt big animals like deer and elk. They also catch rabbits, mice, and sometimes even fish.
Wally is the youngest wolf in the pack. Today he heard a mouse under the snow. He jumped high in the air and dove down nose first.
He came up with a face full of snow and no mouse at all. His big sister laughed a wolfy laugh.
Wolves have amazing noses and ears. Wally can smell a deer from far, far away, and he can hear a howl from miles off.
Grown-up wolves do not have many enemies. But bears, and wolves from other packs, can be dangerous. That is why the pack sticks together.
In the spring, Wally's mom has new pups in a den, a cozy hole in the ground. Everyone in the pack helps take care of them.
At night, Wally curls up and wraps his bushy tail over his nose. It is like a warm, fuzzy blanket.
